CLINICAL DOCUMENTATION — NARRATIVE SURGICAL DISCHARGE SUMMARY V1
Patient: Charles Anderson | MRN: PAT-60013 | DOB: 1959-09-28 | Gender: Male | Doc ID: NARRATIVE_0013
Encounter Date: 2025-05-08 | Discharge/Note Date: 2025-05-12 | Provider: Dr. Allison Cameron, MD
PREOPERATIVE DIAGNOSIS & PROCEDURE
The patient underwent uncomplicated arthroscopic knee meniscectomy and chondroplasty under general endotracheal
anesthesia.
HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS
The patient is an adult who presented electively for surgical intervention following conservative management failure.
Pre-admission testing confirmed that preoperative total cholesterol was 168.2 mg/dL. Preoperative metabolic screening
showed a baseline platelet count of 244.9 10*3/uL. The patient was cleared from a cardiopulmonary standpoint and taken to
the operative suite.
POSTOPERATIVE HOSPITAL COURSE
The patient was extubated in the operating room and transferred to the post-anesthesia care unit in stable condition.
Postoperative recovery was uneventful. For pain and infection prophylaxis, the patient was prescribed Lisinopril 40 mg PO
every morning. On postoperative day one, postoperative alanine aminotransferase (alt) remained stable at 79.3 U/L (HIGH).
Surgical incisions were clean, intact, and without erythema or purulent drainage.
POST-DISCHARGE MEDICATIONS
Discharge medications: The patient will take Metformin 500 mg PO twice daily with meals, and continue baseline
Atorvastatin 80 mg orally every evening. All prescriptions were transmitted electronically to the patient's pharmacy.
ACTIVITY & WOUND CARE PLAN
Keep dressing clean and dry. No heavy lifting greater than 10 pounds for two weeks. Surgical clinic follow-up scheduled in
10 days.
